Players will explore a randomly generated dynamic map, and build and adjust their own decks in it.
Play against girls through cards. Each card can cause damage to different parts of the girls. Players need to use strategies to choose the right cards to defeat them and win!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/37430609/0c712c24befbf0658f15b8b0258a6bfc5aa07188.png[/img]

[h3]Dynamically generated map🗺️[/h3]
Every time you enter the game, a new random map will be generated.

[h3]Mysterious Events🍷[/h3]
There are many mysterious events in the game, triggering different plots or obtaining powerful cards

[h3]Diverse Cards and Combinations🎴[/h3]
Build and customize your own deck, a perfect combination of strategy and cards, more cards and dream stones, making your deck more powerful.

[h3]Two Combat Difficulties🍬[/h3]
